run_get_pr_run_slow_jobs: run the script to suggest slow CI jobs based on modified files in a pull request
run_get_pr_run_slow_jobs_message: run the script with a --message argument to specify models for slow CI from a PR comment
run_get_pr_run_slow_jobs_quantization: run the script with --quantization flag to include quantization tests in slow CI job selection
summarize_parse_message: summarize the parse_message function that extracts model names from a GitHub PR comment after run-slow prefix
test_get_jobs: test the get_jobs function that parses a PR comment message and returns a list of model names to run
